package projectauthoring

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"log/slog"
	"time"
)

type Worker struct {
	Processor    Processor
	PollInterval time.Duration
	Logger       *slog.Logger
}

func (worker Worker) Run(ctx context.Context) {
	interval := worker.PollInterval
	if interval <= 0 {
		interval = 2 * time.Second
	}
	logger := worker.Logger
	if logger == nil {
		logger = slog.Default()
	}
	ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		processed, err := worker.Processor.ProcessNext(ctx)
		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
			logger.ErrorContext(ctx, "project authoring processing failed", "error", err)
		}
		if processed {
			continue
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}
